$comment: Chapter list for the Wilsonic MTS-ESP manual, in reading order. The website (wilsonic.co/documentation) fetches this file, so adding a chapter here plus its <slug>.md is all it takes to publish one. Each slug maps to docs/manual/<slug>.md.

chapters.title: Quick Start
chapters.description: I walk you from install to hearing one of Erv Wilson's scales in about a minute, including the checklist I use when the app seems silent.

chapters.title: Which Wilsonic Is Which
chapters.description: I explain the difference between Wilsonic, WilsonicController, and Wilsonic for iOS, and which of them makes sound by itself.

chapters.title: Installation
chapters.description: I cover installing on macOS and Windows, running as a plugin or standalone, reading the MTS-ESP status indicator, and clean-installing the MTS-ESP library.

chapters.title: MTS-ESP and Your DAW
chapters.description: I explain what MTS-ESP is, how one Wilsonic instance retunes every compatible synth in your session, and the pitch-bend fallback for synths without native support.

chapters.title: The Interface
chapters.description: I tour the microtonal keyboard, the global tuning controls, the pitch wheel, and Favorites — the parts every scale design shares.

chapters.title: Scale Designs
chapters.description: I walk through all thirteen scale designs, from Wilson's Garden to Partch, with screenshots and links to the papers behind them.

chapters.title: Troubleshooting
chapters.description: I answer the questions I get most, starting with why the app seems to make no sound.
